text: Prioritize securing central cells to prevent isolation; if an opponent captures a key connection point, reinforce adjacent cells to maintain territory cohesion.
trigger: An opponent attacks a cell that blocks your expansion into the board's center or connects separate regions of your territory.

text: Prioritize blocking opponent's central-right expansion connections early to prevent them from securing a majority.
trigger: opponent connects central and right-side cells to form a solid block

text: Avoid attacking cells adjacent to your home if it risks losing them, as this weakens your position and allows the opponent to expand closer.
trigger: A cell adjacent to your home is under threat of capture.

text: Avoid allowing the opponent to capture cells that break your contiguous control near your home row, as this isolates your cells and leads to strength loss.
trigger: An opponent's attack severs the connection between your home row and other controlled cells, creating isolated regions.

text: Prioritize attacking enemy expansions into central areas that threaten to connect their territories, as disrupting these links prevents them from building strategic momentum.
trigger: An opponent claims a cell adjacent to your territory in a position that could bridge their disconnected regions or create a central corridor for growth.

text: Prioritize securing central cells to prevent opponent expansion and isolation of your flank.
trigger: When an opponent captures a central cell, threatening your flank connectivity.

text: Prioritize expanding in directions that block the opponent's vertical or horizontal line formation near their home to prevent isolation of your cells.
trigger: Opponent claims a cell adjacent to their home that begins a vertical/horizontal line threatening to cut off your territory.

text: Attack to cut off an enemy cluster from their home when the connection is a single adjacent cell. This forces their isolated cells to lose strength over time while creating expansion opportunities for you.
trigger: An enemy cluster is connected to their home through only one adjacent cell (e.g., a bridge or narrow corridor).

text: Attack opponent's cells adjacent to their home to cut off their expansion and secure strategic positions.
trigger: opponent's cell adjacent to their home

text: Prioritize securing cells that maintain a direct path from your home base to all occupied cells to prevent strength decay from isolation.
trigger: A player's cells are disconnected from their home base, causing them to lose strength over time due to isolation.

text: Prioritize securing central columns (B/C/D) early to maintain expansion flexibility and block opponent connectivity.
trigger: Opponent's expansion threatens to dominate central axis while your home column (A) remains isolated
